# semaphore_ex_project_role (Data Source)

Reads a custom Semaphore EX role.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "semaphore_ex_project_role" "viewer" {
  project_id = semaphore_ex_project.example.id
  id         = semaphore_ex_project_role.viewer.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (Number)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `name` (String)
- `project_permissions` (Set of String)
- `revision` (Number)
- `slug` (String)
